name: Grand Mason Marblesten
summary: Grand Mason Marblesten is an esteemed dwarven stonemason stationed in the busy Commons of Ironforge. Deeply devoted to the royal legacy of Khaz Modan, he has been commissioned by King Magni Bronzebeard to build a memorial to Sully Balloo, a dwarven soldier who died in the Thandol Span tragedy. Adventurers often meet him when assisting with the materials needed to complete this solemn tribute.

sections.title: Master of the Stone
sections.body: Dwarven stonemasonry is not merely a trade; it is an enduring art form that shapes the very soul of Ironforge. Grand Mason Marblesten stands among the city's foremost masters of the chisel, representing the centuries-old tradition of carving halls, pillars, and great effigies straight from the living mountain. Based in the Commons, he oversees civic projects and commemorative monuments that immortalize Bronzebeard history.

sections.title: A King's Tribute
sections.body: Marblesten's most poignant task is a memorial King Magni commissioned for Sully Balloo, a soldier who died in the Thandol Span tragedy, as a tribute to his grieving widow. Wanting a truly lasting piece, the Grand Mason insists on one of the finest stones available: Alterac Granite from Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad.

faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten is a senior dwarven stonemason located in the Commons of Ironforge. He is entrusted with civic and royal sculpting projects, most notably a memorial to the fallen soldier Sully Balloo, commissioned by King Magni Bronzebeard.

faq.q: Where can I find Grand Mason Marblesten?
faq.answer: He can be found in the Commons district of Ironforge, surrounded by stone blocks and architectural works not far from the city's bustling shops and banks.

faq.q: What monument is Marblesten working on?
faq.answer: He is building a memorial to Sully Balloo, a dwarven soldier who died in the Thandol Span tragedy. King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned it in tribute to Balloo and his grieving widow.

faq.q: Why does Marblesten need adventurers to gather materials?
faq.answer: Marblesten wants a truly epic and lasting piece, so he will only work with one of the finest stones available. He sends travelers to Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad to gather Alterac Granite.

faq.q: What does the title 'Grand Mason' mean in dwarven society?
faq.answer: Among dwarves, stoneworking is revered alongside blacksmithing. A 'Grand Mason' is an accomplished master of stonecraft, trusted with major state projects, royal architectural designs, and ceremonial memorials.

faq.q: Is Marblesten an Alliance official or a private contractor?
faq.answer: Marblesten operates directly within Ironforge and serves the Ironforge kingdom and the Alliance, coordinating closely with King Magni Bronzebeard's court for royal commissions.

angles.text: For dwarves, stonecraft is ancestral heritage; aiding Marblesten pays homage both to the craft of Khaz Modan and to the memory of the fallen soldier Sully Balloo.
Miners who work closely with the rock of Dun Morogh and beyond will appreciate Marblesten's exacting standards for raw mineral quality.
Honoring the sacrifice of Sully Balloo reminds the Alliance of every soldier lost in its wars.
